### Summary of Fix (Bug #19868)

The issue arose because text completion for files and directories (triggered by `@` in the interactive CLI) would crash with an uncaught `EISDIR` (Error: Is a Directory) when custom ignore files or `.gitignore` pointed to paths that exist but are directories (such as `node_modules/`, `temp/`, or `cache/`).

These crashes have been resolved with the following focused improvements:

1. **[fileDiscoveryService.ts](file:///usr/local/google/home/joneba/ssr-prototype/gcli-intern-project/tools/caretaker-agent/evals/pr-generation/run_outputs/small_golden_3.5_flash/agent_environments/gemini_cli_19868/tmp/pr/gemini-cli/packages/core/src/services/fileDiscoveryService.ts)**:
   * Replaced the simple existence check for `.gitignore` (`fs.existsSync(...)`) with a safe stat-check (`fs.statSync(..., { throwIfNoEntry: false })?.isFile()`). This prevents directory paths from being treated as `.gitignore` file paths.

2. **[ignore.ts](file:///usr/local/google/home/joneba/ssr-prototype/gcli-intern-project/tools/caretaker-agent/evals/pr-generation/run_outputs/small_golden_3.5_flash/agent_environments/gemini_cli_19868/tmp/pr/gemini-cli/packages/core/src/utils/filesearch/ignore.ts)**:
   * Wrapped the synchronous ignore file reading loop (`fs.readFileSync`) in a defensively implemented `try-catch` block. This prevents any inaccessible files, permission issues, or directories from crashing the CLI.

3. **[ignoreFileParser.ts](file:///usr/local/google/home/joneba/ssr-prototype/gcli-intern-project/tools/caretaker-agent/evals/pr-generation/run_outputs/small_golden_3.5_flash/agent_environments/gemini_cli_19868/tmp/pr/gemini-cli/packages/core/src/utils/ignoreFileParser.ts)**:
   * Replaced the existence filtering check (`fs.existsSync(filePath)`) for ignore paths with a strict stat verification (`fs.statSync(filePath, { throwIfNoEntry: false })?.isFile() ?? false`), ensuring folder paths configured under custom ignore files are correctly filtered out from lists of files to read patterns from.

4. **[fileDiscoveryService.test.ts](file:///usr/local/google/home/joneba/ssr-prototype/gcli-intern-project/tools/caretaker-agent/evals/pr-generation/run_outputs/small_golden_3.5_flash/agent_environments/gemini_cli_19868/tmp/pr/gemini-cli/packages/core/src/services/fileDiscoveryService.test.ts)**:
   * Added unit tests that explicitly test both exclusion of configured directory names from `getIgnoreFilePaths()` / `getAllIgnoreFilePaths()`, and verify that `loadIgnoreRules()` does not crash or throw an error when configuring directory paths under `customIgnoreFilePaths`.

---
